hero.title: About TUIT school of engineering
hero.subtitle: A hub of engineering excellence, innovative research, and industrial integration — we empower the next generation of engineers to shape the digital future of Uzbekistan.

mvv.title: Our Mission
mvv.text: To provide world-class engineering education grounded in research and innovation — nurturing leaders who drive Uzbekistan's digital economy and contribute to global technological advancement.

mvv.title: Our Vision
mvv.text: To become a globally recognised engineering institution by 2030 — producing graduates who redefine technological boundaries and solve humanity's most pressing challenges.

mvv.title: Our Values
mvv.text: Excellence, integrity, innovation, inclusivity and service. We believe every student deserves the tools to succeed and every idea deserves to be heard.

events.event: Established as the Engineering Faculty of the Tashkent Polytechnic Institute.
The first Computer Science department in Central Asia was opened.
Achieved university status following the independence of Uzbekistan.
Renamed as the Tashkent University of Information Technologies (TUIT).
AI Research Center launched in collaboration with international partners.
Ranked as the #1 Engineering School in Central Asia by QS Rankings.
Opening of the new Engineering Innovation Hub — a 12,000 m² state-of-the-art facility.
Launched the first PhD program in Artificial Intelligence in Uzbekistan.

list.title: Application submission
list.desc: Complete the online application form with all personal and academic details.

list.desc: Passport copy, academic certificate, language certificate (ielts 6.0+) and motivation letter.

list.title: Entrance exam
list.desc: Special test in mathematics and major. Top applicants are admitted based on previous academic performance.

list.title: Interview
list.desc: Selected candidates undergo a 30-minute online or face-to-face interview with the program committee.

list.title: Decision receipt
list.desc: All applicants receive admission decisions via email and application portal.

form.title: Start application

programs.title: Computer science and engineering
programs.desc: Algorithms, artificial intelligence, machine learning and software engineering.
programs.details: In this major, you will study modern programming languages, algorithms and fundamentals of ai. Under the guidance of dean prof. akbar toshmatov, you will reinforce theoretical knowledge in real projects for 4 years.

programs.title: Computer engineering
programs.desc: Hardware-software integration, embedded systems and iot applications.
programs.details: The computer engineering major focuses on the relationship between hardware and software. You will learn to design microcontrollers, smart home systems and robotic devices.

programs.title: Information technology
programs.desc: Enterprise systems, cloud architecture and cybersecurity.
programs.details: As an information technology specialist, you will learn to build cloud systems for large enterprises, ensure data security and acquire system administrator skills.

programs.title: Data science
programs.desc: Big data, statistical modeling and business analytics.
programs.details: In this major, under the guidance of dr. nilufar yusupova, you will learn data analysis and creating predictive models. This is one of the most in-demand professions in the market today.

programs.title: Electrical engineering
programs.desc: Energy systems, signal processing and smart grids.
programs.details: The electrical engineering major studies renewable energy sources and telecommunications equipment. Under the guidance of prof. sherzod rakhimov, you will gain deep knowledge about smart grids.

programs.title: Artificial intelligence
programs.desc: Deep learning, nlp, computer vision and robotics research.
programs.details: This advanced research track is intended for graduate and doctoral students only. You will conduct experiments in labs for neural networks, speech recognition and creating autonomous robots.
